text: {"observations":"Both spectrograms show nearly continuous speech across the full 14.7 s, with dense voiced harmonic stacks below about 1 kHz and only brief gaps (e.g. near 3.7 s, 5.8-6.4 s and 11 s). I estimate roughly 40-50 syllable-like energy bursts, which implies about 35-40 words at a normal speaking rate. Since most words, including monosyllables, carry a stressed phoneme, the count should be near thirty. This is an estimate from speech density, not an exact count; it rules out 3, 11 and 15 as far too low and favours B.","answer":"B"}
